$comment: Template for config/webui.json. SnowLuma generates the real file on first
Do not commit the generated file: even though it stores a hash rather than a
password, it is the credential that unlocks the panel, and a hash is
offline-crackable. If you need to reset the password, delete the generated
file and let the next start produce a new bootstrap password.
passwordHash: <generated on first start - do not commit>
passwordSalt: <generated on first start - do not commit>
